name: gatepulse-fabric-sql-demo
description: Demo: run ad hoc SQL on an on-prem / IP-filtered database through a Microsoft Fabric pipeline (Lookup activity + gateway connection), driven by the Fabric REST API.

gatepulse.tenants.description: Tenants/workspaces available in the panel and in "GatePulse: Switch Tenant". No project/repo needed — GatePulse is used standalone, like the mssql extension: this lives in User Settings by default, not tied to a workspace.

workspaceId.description: Fabric workspace GUID — where the generic pipeline lives, or will be auto-provisioned.

clientId.description: Optional: app registration override for this tenant (otherwise gatepulse.clientId).

pipelineId.description: Optional: manual override, skips auto-provisioning for this tenant.

connectionGuid.description: Optional: gateway connection GUID pre-filled in the panel.

databaseName.description: Optional: database name pre-filled in the panel.

gatepulse.clientId.description: Optional. Leave empty to sign in with Microsoft's first-party public client (same as Azure CLI / FabricPulse). Set only if you have your own app registration allowed for user sign-in. Overridden per tenant by gatepulse.tenants[].clientId.

gatepulse.authFlow.description: auto = reuse the Azure CLI session (az login) if present, otherwise open the browser. azureCli = Azure CLI only. interactive = browser only. deviceCode = device code flow.

gatepulse.scopes.description: Token scopes. The first-party client (empty clientId) only supports .default.

gatepulse.pollIntervalMs.description: Job status polling interval (ms). Kept short on purpose: it bounds latency measurement precision.

gatepulse.timeoutMs.description: Max wait for job completion (ms). On timeout the job is cancelled.

gatepulse.activityNames.description: Query activities whose output is read (Lookup / Script). Empty = every Lookup and Script activity of the run.

gatepulse.parameterPayloadFormat.description: How parameters are sent to the job API. executionData = {executionData:{parameters:{...}}} (pipeline format). typedParameters = {parameters:[{name,value,type}]} (generic Job Scheduler format).

gatepulse.parameterNames.description: Parameter names as declared in the Fabric pipeline (run `inspect` to see them), e.g. {"connectionGuid":"_conn","databaseName":"_dbname","query":"_Query"}.

gatepulse.logDirectory.description: Folder for JSONL logs and reports. Empty = extension global storage.

gatepulse.validation.concurrency.description: Number of parallel runs for the concurrency test (P3).

gatepulse.validation.alternateConnection.description: Second gateway connection GUID for the connection swap test (P4).

gatepulse.validation.alternateDatabaseNa.description: Database name used with the alternate connection (P4).

gatepulse.validation.referenceUiJobInsta.description: Optional: job instance ID of a run triggered manually from the Fabric UI, used to diff the Lookup input against an API-triggered run (P4).

gatepulse.validation.identityQuery.default: SELECT @@SERVERNAME AS server_name, DB_NAME() AS database_name, SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name
gatepulse.validation.identityQuery.description: Query revealing which server/database answered (P4). T-SQL by default.

gatepulse.validation.markerQueryTemplate.default: SELECT '{{tag}}' AS run_tag, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS server_time
gatepulse.validation.markerQueryTemplate.description: Query template for the concurrency test (P3). {{tag}} is replaced by a unique per-run tag.

gatepulse.validation.rowCountQueryTempla.default: SELECT TOP ({{n}}) ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) AS i FROM sys.all_objects a CROSS JOIN sys.all_objects b
gatepulse.validation.rowCountQueryTempla.description: Query template returning exactly {{n}} rows, for the row cap test (P1). T-SQL by default.

gatepulse.validation.rowCapSizes.description: Row counts requested by the row cap test.

gatepulse.validation.latencyQuery.description: Simple query used by the latency test (P2).

gatepulse.validation.latencyIterations.description: Sequential iterations for the latency test (P2).

gatepulse.validation.sizeTestRows.description: Row counts for the payload size test (4 MB limit), with ~4 KB rows.

gatepulse.validation.sizeQueryTemplate.default: SELECT TOP ({{n}}) ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) AS i, REPLICATE(CAST('x' AS varchar(max)), 4000) AS pad FROM sys.all_objects a CROSS JOIN sys.all_objects b
gatepulse.validation.sizeQueryTemplate.description: Query returning {{n}} wide rows for the size test. T-SQL by default.
